title: Not their usual exceptional standard.
text: Not their usual exceptional standard.. Bought on line. It's much bigger than I realized and doesn't toast evenly.  Also, the digital printout of temp is very hard to read at counter hight. Bought this because I own three other Breville products a love them all. This sadly, was disappointing.

product_metadata.title: Breville CT75XL Ikon 4-Slice Electric Toaster
features: 1500-watt 4-slice toaster housed in premium brushed stainless steel
Wide, self-centering toasting slots; "toast ready" sound alert; high-lift lever
Lift-and-look function for checking progress without interrupting cycle
LCD display; browning control dial; bagel, defrost, and reheat settings
Measures 14 by 5-1/2 by 8 inches; 1 Year limited warranty
description: Housed in premium brushed stainless steel, this sleek-looking four-slice toaster provides extra-wide and deep toasting slots that easily accommodate thicker breads, bagels, or frozen waffles. The slots are self-centering for even toasting, while the high-lift lever makes it simple to remove smaller items. The unit also offers a "lift-and-look" feature that allows for lifting the toast lever any time throughout the toasting progress to monitor toasting without interrupting the cooking cycle. The toaster's LCD display indicates the toasting progress, and its control panel includes an electronic browning control dial and three special setting options--bagel, defrost, and reheat--plus a cancel button to end the cycle at any time. A "toast ready" sound alerts when the toasted item is ready to enjoy. Other highlights include a removable crumb tray for quick crumb disposal and handy cord storage in the base to help keep countertops tidy. The 1500-watt toaster measures 14 by 5-1/2 by 8 inches and carries a limited lifetime warranty.
